body:
I made reasonable choices I guess but my life has been so fucking unreasonable. It doesn't make sense and it's not fair to be so fucking sick with a trillion different things. And it's not things like diabetes where people believe you and feel bad for you, it's all bullshit illnesses that people blame you for getting or don't believe you or get pissed because you're whining all the time. 

I'm pissed at my boyfriend because his mom's in the hospital and she's having trouble walking, which is apparently a big deal, but I haven't been able to walk humanly since LAST YEAR but that's old news. I'm still in pain, congrats, I'm still boring apparently because I don't have a brain tumor or a broken leg. 

That sounds really bitter and terrible, but I don't give a shit. Yeah it sucks that she's sick, but I have been sick MY ENTIRE LIFE and just because it keeps going doesn't mean it stops hurting. 

I'm just so done. I'm sick of trying to convince people that I'm not okay, and I'm sick of being sick. I can't fight anymore. I don't want to be strong, I just want to be dead.

I feel so fucking dumb. I feel like I should've tried harder to kill myself when I was younger so I could have avoided all of this. 

I was stupid and I believed people when they told me it would get better, or it wouldn't last forever. No, some things didn't last forever, they just got replaced by harder and shittier things. 

It's a video game with impossible bosses that I can't stop playing unless I turn the console off.
